SELECT it.it_ticket_id AS id, it.title, it.STATUS_CODE AS status, rt.EMPLOYEE_NAME AS requesterName, asn.EMPLOYEE_NAME AS assigneeName, it.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM it_ticket it
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE rt ON rt.COMPANY_ID = it.COMPANY_ID AND rt.EMPLOYEE_ID = it.REQUESTER_EMPLOYEE_ID
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE asn ON asn.COMPANY_ID = it.COMPANY_ID AND asn.EMPLOYEE_ID = it.ASSIGNEE_EMPLOYEE_ID
WHERE it.company_id = #{companyId} AND it.asset_id = #{assetId} AND it.ticket_type = #{ticketType} ORDER BY it.CREATED_AT DESC, it.it_ticket_id DESC

SELECT aa.asset_assignment_id AS assetAssignmentId, aa.asset_id AS assetId, aa.employee_id AS employeeId, receiver.employee_name AS employeeName, aa.it_ticket_id AS itTicketId, aa.issued_by AS issuedBy, issuer.employee_name AS issuedByName, aa.issued_at AS issuedAt, aa.returned_by AS returnedBy, returner.employee_name AS returnedByName, aa.returned_at AS returnedAt FROM asset_assignment aa
LEFT JOIN employee receiver ON receiver.company_id = aa.company_id AND receiver.employee_id = aa.employee_id
LEFT JOIN user_account issue_account ON issue_account.company_id = aa.company_id AND issue_account.user_account_id = aa.issued_by
LEFT JOIN employee issuer ON issuer.company_id = issue_account.company_id AND issuer.employee_id = issue_account.employee_id
LEFT JOIN user_account return_account ON return_account.company_id = aa.company_id AND return_account.user_account_id = aa.returned_by
LEFT JOIN employee returner ON returner.company_id = return_account.company_id AND returner.employee_id = return_account.employee_id
WHERE aa.company_id = #{companyId} AND aa.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY aa.issued_at DESC, aa.asset_assignment_id DESC

select asset_id as id, asset_no as assetNo, asset_name as name, serial_no as serial, asset_type as kind, status_code as status, branch_id as branchId, version from asset where company_id = #{companyId} order by asset_no, asset_id
SELECT asset_id, asset_name, asset_no, serial_no, asset_type, status_code AS status, branch_id, version FROM asset WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId}
SELECT company_id, asset_id, asset_type, status_code AS status, branch_id, version FROM asset WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT asset_assignment_id FROM asset_assignment WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND returned_at IS NULL

UPDATE asset SET status_code = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND status_code = #{status} AND version = #{version}
